name: hp-benchmark-hard
description: A set of challenging (hard) problems designed to stress-test language models on difficult question-answering and reasoning items, focusing on cases where standard models tend to fail. The benchmark measures robust problem-solving, multi-step reasoning, and the ability to handle adversarial or uncommon input formulations. It is intended to separate stronger reasoning systems from baseline models.
reputation: A relatively obscure and narrowly used hard-split benchmark hosted on Hugging Face; modest community adoption so far.
